fullDesc: On August 24, 2006 the International Astronomical Union voted to define a planet in a way that excluded Pluto, which became a dwarf planet. The decision followed the discovery of similar objects such as Eris.
realFacts: Pluto was discovered in 1930 by Clyde Tombaugh
New Horizons flew by it in 2015
Its heart-shaped glacier was a surprise
Some astronomers still object to the decision
